cloud_receipts: RC33 baselines uploaded, deferred and local historical flights while WebUI is stopped at the install boundary, filters delayed-old receipts, and atomically claims each future delivery at most once across reboots.
controlled_parent: Exact published and installed RC32 source tree; RC32 failed practical Home-marker geometry and historical receipt-replay acceptance and is retained only as an exact recovery source.
home_marker: RC33 enforces strict numeric telemetry and armed-live/disarmed-bench isolation, preserves native ArduPilot quaternion geometry and deterministic rear-edge projection, and accepts SIYI gimbal attitude only from the authoritative system/component/device source.
hotfix_state: No mutable hotfix. RC33 is a new immutable candidate; RC32 is consumed and non-promotable.
operator_workflow: Publish, independently verify, run the exact RC32 read-only preflight, then use FlightCore Software Update.
packaging_correction: Public install.sh is generated only from source public-install.sh and is byte-identical to the archive-tested member; internal install.sh substitution is rejected.
public_bootstrap: Self-contained RC33 bootstrap; no companion shell helper is required.
registry_gate: Exact RC32/RC31/RC30/RC28/RC26 recovery, accepted RC24, represented historical routes and genuine fresh installation; modified and unknown sources fail closed.
simulation_safety: The same-level 2 km imaginary Home is available only while explicitly disarmed and uses the exact live path; armed, non-false, stale, unknown or disconnected state fails closed and erases it.
